'''Salon pods''' were the forward lower sections of [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]].

==Characteristics==
It contained amenities for [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and passengers during long space voyages, and in emergencies could be detached from the cruiser to serve as an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].

Salon pods were heavily armored and sealed against all forms of probing or bugging, and so were often used as an ideal location for direct negotiatons and diplomacy.
